scientific_integrity: All claims follow from exhaustive algebraic path enumeration and polynomial sign analysis, with finite exact-rational reproducibility checks. Source comparison is same-model only and cannot eliminate unindexed literature.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for a two-coordinate, two-component strongly convex quadratic interpolation family after one epoch at component-Lipschitz reciprocal stepsize. No universal or later-epoch dominance statement.
title: A sharp one-epoch reshuffling reversal on strongly convex quadratics
